reviews.text: I recommend them 100%. I received wonderful treatment from Borja, and my 1-year-old American Staffordshire Terrier has changed a lot thanks to his guidelines in 2-3 months.

They've helped me understand my dog ​​better. He used to bark constantly at other dogs, and thanks to Borja, we've been able to understand why and see our furry friend from a different perspective. Whether you're having problems or not, and you want to communicate with your dog, they're the people you need.

Emilio is an extremely polite person. He has always treated Milo with great respect and has helped and supported us immensely during this particular time of a dog's adolescence. We continue with his classes; we've only had two, but we've already learned so much from him, not only how to behave with our own dog, but also how to understand his needs and how to meet them, how to better understand our dog's language, and how to best support him. Thank you so much, Emilio! After two "trainers" from Valencia, we've finally found someone who can truly help us on this journey, and others as well, with respect for our dog.

Ultimately, we couldn't treat the dog we were fostering because she wasn't ready for city life, and the best decision for her well-being was to return her to the shelter. But if you're looking for serious, dedicated, and committed trainers, don't hesitate to call them. They were always quick and professional—a 10 out of 10!

Borja is the best dog trainer there is because he doesn't just train dogs; he understands the situations, teaches people, and helps dogs feel better. My dog, Cooper (an 8-year-old Golden Retriever), had never had any problems, but we moved, and the change affected him a lot. He barked every morning when he was left alone; he wasn't comfortable in the new house. Borja (highly recommended) came to explain the guidelines and how to help Cooper in two sessions, helping us understand what was happening to him. He's always been in contact with us. The work has to be done by the family, though. Don't think that trainers come and fix everything in a day. Dogs are creatures of habit, and the people who live with them have to adapt, guided by the trainers. So, I would always recommend him. The price is more than affordable (believe me, don't trust those who tell you about training for €600).

Borja is incredibly dedicated to his work. He's a tremendous help, provides excellent guidance, and, above all, teaches you to understand your dog better. Thanks to him, you learn to interpret many behaviors and situations you previously couldn't understand.

His work helps dogs become calm and well-balanced animals, and allows both you and your dog to feel much better at home.

In my case, he helped me immensely with Toti, and I will always be grateful to him. When Toti arrived, I had no idea how to handle many situations, and Borja explained everything to me from the beginning, supporting us and providing excellent follow-up.

Today, Toti is a calm and well-balanced dog, and we owe a large part of that change to Borja. I highly recommend him.

Emilio was a genius! He gave us specific instructions on how to modify our behavior, and we were able to resolve our problem. He's also always keeping an eye on how things are progressing. Highly recommended!

Borja has been a great help in understanding the calm our dogs need both at home and outdoors. Their behavior has improved significantly, and now we need to continue working with him, but with excellent advice. Highly recommended. Thank you.
Talking to Borja and receiving his advice was a great help in my case; dependence in dogs is a complicated situation and help like that provided by Borja and his partner is key.

I'm giving 5 stars because I can't give 12! Emilio is a great trainer and an even better person! My dog ​​came from a pretty cruel training camp and skipped developmental stages. Thanks to Emilio, I understood that, and now I give him quality walks and know how to treat him better. Thank you, Emilio!
Borja and his partner are great guys, they help me a lot with my two dogs. I highly recommend them!!

We had a wonderful experience. We have a puppy with many fears (going to the groomer, the doorbell, the street...) and he has improved tremendously thanks to Borja's guidance. He is very patient and adapts perfectly to the situation. We would definitely use him again!

We've had Emilio on board since our puppy came to us at two months old. He's helped us a lot with the whole process, guiding us on what to do and how to act at each stage of her development, as it was all new to us. A year later, we have a well-balanced and happy dog. 100% recommended.
I'm very happy with Borja's work. With a few key tips, my dog ​​is no longer afraid to go outside. Thank you so much!

Perhaps this isn't the right approach for every dog. And I'm not saying this because of Borja or Emilio, who are wonderful, but because of the method. After the first session, we weren't satisfied because, in our case, with a very energetic puppy, what we needed was much more discipline than the guidelines they gave us, which were far too simplistic. And although they had very good reviews after speaking with other dog owners who had similar experiences with other trainers, it's important to understand that there are different approaches to dog training, and perhaps some dogs need to be told "no" and have a much stricter approach. Anyway, it's like anything else, try it out and see what you think.

Borja is a great trainer. He's knowledgeable and has given us some very sensible advice on how to improve the behavior of Koda, our dog.

He gave us guidelines for creating a calm environment for our dog. Since then, her relationship with other dogs has improved significantly.

A very good first impression from Borja. He explained the dog's problems and how to address them, providing guidelines and a lot of information. Now we'll work with him at home, and as soon as he's ready, we'll continue the sessions outside.

I've had the pleasure of meeting Borja, and thanks to him, we've been able to acquire tools that have allowed us to improve our dog's daily life. We adopted Boro when he was 3 or 4 years old, and given his past, he didn't handle being alone well (he cried, wet himself, and so on). With Borja, we learned to understand a little better what was happening, and he taught us how to handle the situation. We didn't see results from one week to the next, but by consistently applying certain behaviors and playing games, we've seen great improvements in how Boro manages being alone. We still have the occasional bad day, but they happen less and less.

Super happy!

I recommend him 100%.
Borja has been a huge help with Popa. He's not my first dog, but he is my first puppy, and I was having a hard time understanding his stress. He's always very attentive to our needs, thank you 🤍 …

My experience with Borja from WalkingDogsValencia has been fantastic. He helped me a lot to understand my dog ​​Nika, and with simple advice, everything improved. His support and guidance are invaluable, as the well-being of our furry friends and ourselves depends on it. Life becomes so much easier when things change. My Nika is happy, and so am I.
